purpose: Contract governance, SDK distribution and cross-repository compatibility. Not a runtime gateway.

authority: Testagram-native access-token issuance and live-session validation
authenticated creator video channel, upload, processing-status and publish orchestration
services.auth: Testagram-native short-lived access JWT; PostgreSQL session/account checks on every protected request; opaque rotating refresh token accepted only by /api/auth/refresh; no external identity-provider bearer fallback on end-user routes
services.notes: Current Backend mainline is 946ad8c08696003334cf1b634b611aa03cb76ca5 (merged PR #551). It is the sole identity, session, authorization and canonical product-data authority. The Flutter-used method/path surface is checked against the Backend route inventory and public OpenAPI by API contract CI. Native signup remains fail-closed behind identity review. Message reaction and sender-only deletion are implemented; encrypted send/edit/attachment remain E2EE_NOT_READY. Call and Audio Spaces lifecycle records are metadata only until public realtime/WebRTC transport and a group SFU pass acceptance. Backend has typed Data Centre clients for private media, identity evidence and video processing APIs; creator channel/upload/status/publish routes proxy through the authenticated Backend to the private video service. Flutter never receives the private video-service URL or its credentials. This does not imply a generic platform-control-plane client. Backend CI and security checks passed on the pinned SHA; production deployment and live staging acceptance are not established by source CI.

authority: Testagram-native login, refresh, recovery and session restoration
services.auth: Uses Backend-native login and rotating refresh credentials; stores only the refresh token in platform secure storage; access token stays in memory
services.notes: Current Flutter mainline is ad217a528b5059fba03ade6a589d39a91a572f2a; Flutter CI run 45867560762 and validation run 45867560468 passed on that exact SHA. API contract CI run 45868112697 passed against the current API mainline and pinned client source. Auth, profile, feed, posts/replies/interactions, threads, discovery/search/hashtags, polls, knowledge, lists, history, notifications, federation preferences, wallet and supported media operations use the public Backend contract. Flutter does not call private microservices directly. Messaging exposes only supported metadata/reaction/delete behavior; plaintext and encrypted send/edit/attachments remain disabled pending E2EE device trust and decryption. Calls and Audio Spaces are lifecycle/UI foundations only pending realtime transport, WebRTC media encryption and an SFU. Monetization destinations are navigable foundations; campaign, earnings, premium/subscription, boost, payout and gifts/tips workflows do not yet have complete Backend ledger/provider contracts. Video service direct ingress remains unavailable and must not be pointed at the general API origin.

services.auth: PLATFORM_INTERNAL_TOKEN for protected platform writes; video and notification user routes validate Backend-native access JWTs against live PostgreSQL session/account state; user tokens are never platform service credentials
services.notes: Current Data Centre mainline is 9785fd7d13e572319d60c7694ad1cabb8bcc81dd and its CI passed on that exact SHA. It owns storage mechanics, media lifecycle providers, video processing, notification delivery infrastructure, platform operations and backups; it does not own product identity, visibility or authorization. Backend has typed, direction-specific clients for private media and identity-evidence APIs, with separate service credentials. The generic platform config/events/audit listener is a distinct private control-plane API and is not a product API; no generic Backend client is claimed. The Flutter notification SSE path reads the canonical Backend inbox directly; Data Centre notification workers are not a second inbox authority. The video service listener is not publicly routed by the current Caddy ingress. Live provider, storage durability, staging and restore acceptance remain separate from source CI.

services.auth: Backend-issued short-lived viewer assertion for private media; separate origin and purge credentials; raw user access JWT is not forwarded as a CDN origin credential
services.notes: Current CDN mainline is e0a6e0fd22c934a5bfb6a0a4b9686f33e0fa5ab7. CI, source verification and container publication passed on that exact SHA. The CDN is a byte-delivery plane for public/private media, HLS/DASH, range requests and cache invalidation; Backend remains the authorization and visibility authority. Private media requires Backend viewer assertions and separately authenticated origins/purge operations. A green build or published image does not prove that media.testagram.site DNS, TLS, edge routing, origin reachability, private-media denial or byte-range behavior are live and correct; those require staging/live endpoint acceptance.

authority: signed delivery of Backend-authorized public Create activities
public dereferencing of Backend-canonical ActivityPub Notes
AT Protocol public author-feed adapter and DID allowlist projection
services.auth: Public ActivityPub ingress uses HTTP Signatures; Backend-to-Federation uses a distinct service bearer; Federation-to-Backend uses a different service bearer
services.notes: Current Federation mainline is 0f25d853e5ea5ac546eb1d05847086d387eb2a1c; CI and image publication passed on that exact SHA. Federation owns ActivityPub/AT Protocol protocol state, keys, inbox/outbox and remote delivery; Backend remains authoritative for local identities, follows, blocks, visibility and moderation. The Backend private bridge and protocol adapters are source-present, but delivery/inbox/outbox workers remain disabled by default until signatures, consent, replay protection, idempotency, durability, interoperability and staging gates pass. Source CI is not proof of live federation interoperability.

authority: ranking order and ranking scores only
ranking of Backend-authorized public hashtag candidates
services.notes: Current Algorithm mainline is 3b6a54d5978f8dc33b853698366c0adc110f9614; ranking CI and image publication passed on that exact SHA. Backend sends bounded, already-authorized candidate IDs to private ranking endpoints; Algorithm returns ordering/scores only. Backend rejects unknown/duplicate IDs and rechecks visibility, blocks, follows and moderation before hydrating canonical records. Algorithm has no public client API and Flutter never calls it. Private service authentication, timeout/fallback behavior, load and staging acceptance remain distinct from source CI.
